description.value: Click the gate in Sunstone Valley. In the world, the Sandscale Oasis shows as a red map marker (15 m, 107 m, 131 m, 133 m in different frames). The Sunstone Valley region panel lists "Sandscale Oasis" with Rough Rider Raceway, Sunstone Valley Approach, The Rumbledome, Precursor Ruins, Red's Haven, Whirly's Scrap Camp and Glimmerdeep Hydropower Dam. The client sends players "to the summit of Sandscale Oasis" (loc 115298841, 1245206620) and says "Go to Sandscale Oasis" (loc 4093910411). Atlas icon exists. A loading card reads "Sandscale Oasis". | [wiki] [client] [video ns0rlvCjXtU/00302, fMOGHMuA2Hc/00012, 00064, 00090, b6QfVC_2YpQ/00028, rWTxDOHv-eY/00214]
